# lettermint_projects (Data Source)

List Lettermint projects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lettermint_projects" "all" {
  sort = ["name"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `page_size` (Number) Results requested per API page. The API default is 30.
- `search` (String)
- `sort` (List of String) Sort values in API order. The API default is -created_at.

### Read-Only

- `projects` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `domains_count` (Number)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `routes_count` (Number)
- `smtp_enabled` (Boolean)
- `updated_at` (String)
